pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū acchinnacīvarake bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.4: acchinnacīvarassa vā naṭṭhacīvarassa vā aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.9: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aññātake gahapatike upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.13: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso sabhāyaṃ nisinno aññataraṃ purisaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.19: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ cīvaraṃ viññāpessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.20: dussavāṇijjaṃ vā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā karissanti, paggāhikasālaṃ vā pasāressantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.21: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.22: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.23: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ cīvaraṃ viññāpessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.24: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.25: “saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ cīvaraṃ viññāpethā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.28: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ cīvaraṃ viññāpessatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.30: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:1.31.1: “tañce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santaruttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttariṃ sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.1.4: mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.1.13: santaruttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.1.14: sace tīṇi naṭṭhāni honti dve sāditabbāni, dve naṭṭhāni ekaṃ sāditabbaṃ, ekaṃ naṭṭhaṃ na kiñci sāditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.1.18: nissajitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.1.21: “idamme bhante cīvaraṃ aññātakaṃ gahapatikaṃ tatuttariṃ viññāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.2.1.1: aññātake aññātakasaññī tatuttariṃ cīvaraṃ viññāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.2.3: aññātake ñātakasaññī tatuttariṃ cīvaraṃ viññāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
